Preserve the source as a first-person voxel sandbox: split touch zones for movement/look, tap-to-place on targeted block faces, tool-slot removal, hotbar/inventory, jump/fly, collision, procedural chunks, central hole, and reset/fall-loop feedback. Transform the presentation into a cozy satirical spell-school city builder: a decora-kei cat-witch planner zones pastel cottage blocks around a cursed Budget Basilisk Audit Pit. Use fairycore/cottagecore colors, bows, stars, mushrooms, warm lanterns, readable mobile HUD copy, meme-tone cues like "slay queen fly", and compact bedtime-session onboarding. blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: first-person sandbox voxel/block builder with endless procedural terrain and a central fall hazard.
- objective: freely explore, place blocks against targeted faces, clear blocks with a tool slot, manage a hotbar/inventory, and survive or reset after falling through the central shaft loop.
- input model: mobile-first split touch controls; left half drags movement, right half drags camera look and short taps interact; hotbar buttons select block/tool; jump and fly controls are separate buttons; settings/inventory modals use native click/tap.
- core loop: start run, generate chunks around player, move/look, select a block type, aim at a block within reach, tap to place or clear, receive feedback, continue building/exploring, reset when desired or after deep fall loop.
- fail/friction state: no conventional loss; friction is placement blocked by player collision, out-of-range targeting, falling into the hole, glitch/depth feedback, and manual reset.

## Protected Mechanics
- Preserve Three.js first-person camera, chunk generation cadence, block map keys, 1x1x1 voxel placement/removal, raycast reach, collision box, gravity/jump/fly behavior, infinite fall loop, hotbar/inventory semantics, reset/settings flows, and mobile split-touch input semantics.

## Safe Theming Surfaces
HUD copy, item names/icons/colors/materials, start/inventory/settings language, procedural terrain visual treatment, lights/fog/sky, feedback captions, audio labels, particles, CSS panels, background overlays, and decorative non-colliding scene motifs may change aggressively.
